reference.final_report: Replaced the split-based parser with the standard csv reader and added deterministic duplicate-header validation while retaining the existing row-width error class. Quoted commas and doubled quotes now round-trip, blank optional values remain empty strings, and a duplicate header fails before row processing. The focused public matrix keeps the original single-row test and adds valid quoting, escaped quotes, blank fields, duplicate-header, and row-width cases; all data is local and deterministic.

partial.final_report: Switched to CSV quoting but did not reject duplicate headers or preserve a distinct row-width error. Quoted values work while malformed input classification remains incomplete.

wrong.final_report: Removed the quoted fixture and relaxed row-width checks so every line is accepted. The parser appears green only because malformed inputs are no longer asserted.
